'''2020 TMW Pods Adam Fletcher LS The Galaxy May Need A Legend''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Adam Fletcher]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Adam Fletcher]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
